title: A short exact sequence of coherent formal modules is levelwise right exact, and the kernel levels are quotients of levelwise kernels
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space) and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, and let $0\to(\mathcal G_n)\xrightarrow{\beta}(\mathcal F_n)\xrightarrow{\alpha}(\mathcal H_n)\to0$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] in the abelian category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian], with components $\beta_n:\mathcal G_n\to\mathcal F_n$ and $\alpha_n:\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal H_n$. Then: (a) for every $n\ge1$ the sequence $\mathcal G_n\xrightarrow{\beta_n}\mathcal F_n\xrightarrow{\alpha_n}\mathcal H_n\to0$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is exact in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (exact at $\mathcal F_n$, and $\alpha_n$ surjective); (b) for every $n\ge1$ there are an integer $m\ge n$ and a surjective $\mathcal O_X$-linear map from the $\mathcal O_X$-module $\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_m)\subseteq\mathcal F_m$ onto $\mathcal G_n$. (In general $\beta_n$ is not injective.)

proof.text: Install the abelian structure supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. For the evaluation functor at index n, that same theorem supplies a colimiting cokernel cofork of the first arrow and a colimiting evaluated cofork. Apply preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone. The second arrow is a cokernel by [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-epi-cokernel]; ShortComplex.Exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel gives evaluated exactness, and Cofork.IsColimit.epi applied to CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit gives the component epimorphism.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module-kernel] to the second arrow. Its unique factorization property constructs IsLimit of the kernel fork via KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι. The first arrow is a kernel by [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-short-exact-kernel]. IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso therefore gives an isomorphism from the constructed kernel K to the first term of the complex; the inclusion functor maps it to an isomorphism of inverse systems.

proof.text: At index n+c the image comparison in [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module-kernel] identifies T_(n+c) with the abelian image of Ker(alpha_(n+c+c)) → F_(n+c). Compose Abelian.factorThruImage with the inverse of this comparison, formalModuleQuotientπ at exponent n+1, the quotient comparison to K_n, and the component of K ≅ G. Every factor is epi: the image corestriction and cokernel projection by Mathlib abelian-category instances, and the comparison maps by their isomorphism instances. Their composite is epi and n ≤ n+c+c. This uses positive level n+1 throughout and makes no injectivity assertion for G_n → F_n.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 0CYV (first paragraph) and 087X (proof). (a): alpha is a cokernel of beta (exact at F, alpha epi; lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-epi-cokernel (a)); the abelian node gives the termwise cokernel; the two cokernels differ by an isomorphism with isomorphic components, so alpha_n = phi_n o q_n is surjective with kernel Im beta_n. (b): beta is a kernel of alpha (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-abelian-short-exact-kernel, ShortComplex.ShortExact.fIsKernel); the explicit kernel (K'_{n+c}/I^n K'_{n+c}) of 087X claims (a)-(d) is stated in the new node lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module-kernel, because the statement of lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian describes only cokernels (its Steps 3-6 prove the kernel description in its proof only); with m = n + 2c, Ker(alpha_m) -> K'_{n+c} -> K_n -> G_n is the required surjection. Added def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence to the statement (citation) and stmt_deps. The remark that beta_n need not be injective is justified by the kernel node.

reviewed.note: Four steps: uniqueness of kernels/cokernels up to isomorphism (termwise), (a) from the termwise cokernels of the abelian node, (b) from the explicit kernel of alpha in Coh(X,I) (new unsplit node stating the proof of 087X: stabilized images K'_m and K_n = K'_{n+c}/I^n K'_{n+c}), with m = n+2c, via a new leaf (in an abelian category the first map of a short exact sequence is a kernel of the second: ShortExact.fIsKernel ShortExact.lean:162 verified). Correct. Statement: citation of def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence added. lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_shortExact_levels (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (S : ShortComplex (CoherentFormalModule X I)) (hS : S.ShortExact) : (∀ n : ℕ, (S.map ((IsCoherentFormalModule I).ι ⋙ (evaluation ℕᵒᵖ X.Modules).obj (op n))).Exact ∧ Epi (S.g.hom.app (op n))) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, n ≤ m ∧ ∃ q : kernel (S.g.hom.app (op m)) ⟶ S.X₁.obj.obj (op n), Epi q)
